Subsystem: Boot chain, AVB and boot control
Mainline SoC support: Not a kernel SoC driver question
NX809J board status: Fastboot confirms product canoe, unlocked yes, secure yes, userspace no, current A, two slots. A is successful/not unbootable with six retries; B is unsuccessful/not unbootable with zero. Android A returned with root and unchanged kernel. Temporary fastboot boot untested. Android AIDL boot-control service present; legacy HIDL client fails
Firmware and service dependencies: Bootloader, AVB/vbmeta chain, Android AIDL boot-control interface, initramfs
Test required to claim support: Controlled temporary boot of a finished Linux image, then return to Android A and verify both slot metadata and data
Blocker or next gate: Do not target B or add switch tools yet. has-slot boot=yes and system=no; unsupported other names do not mean absent. Linux-side AIDL/qbootctl path is untested

Blocker or next gate: sda has no unallocated space; largest other-LUN gap is under 364 MiB. Personal/app backup is incomplete; partition readback is not a user-data backup
